quality_review: Same assistant, masked model labels per pair; not an independent or fully blinded study

rubric.coherence: 0 empty/unintelligible; 1 understandable with major contradictions/repetition; 2 connected understandable English
rubric.story_ending: assess only a completed, EOS-ended story; otherwise not assessable
rubric.questions: manually judge first answer; lexical signal alone is not proof
rubric.instructions: exact-output rules or rain sentence heuristic plus manual judgement
rubric.repetition: flag if any fourgram occurs at least three times or a word repeats three times consecutively
